snippet.title: House of Saturn - Official Playtest Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Playtest Trailer for House of Saturn, a dark psychological horror game developed by XCATHEDRA Games. Players will explore the demonic halls of a 1920s university in England to solve puzzles and evade a sinister demon in the process. House of Saturn is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
